dataset_product: Odense municipality districts (SHP/GPKG; also embedded in accessibility GPKGs)
provider_source: Local Map Layers (GIS export; original SDFE/DAGI municipal boundary)
spatial_resolution_geometry: Polygon districts (30 districts in walk GPKG layer)
filter_rules_or_tags: Union of districts = municipal study boundary
aggregation_to_500m_hex: Defines clip boundary for hex grid
notes_limitations: Local project file

dataset_product: Canonical analysis hexes from walking_accessibility_500m_hexagons (n=1539); source Map Layers Odense-500mHexaCells clipped to municipality
provider_source: Local Map Layers / prior accessibility run
spatial_resolution_geometry: Regular hexagons, 500 m; n=1,539 after clip; municipality area ~304.37 km2
filter_rules_or_tags: Clipped to municipal boundary; Stage B merges indicators on centroid cell_key
notes_limitations: All indicators aggregated to this grid

dataset_product: OpenStreetMap walk network + amenity/shop/leisure POIs
year_or_download_date: Exact OSM retrieval timestamp not stored; analysis GPKG 2026-06-01; reused in v1 2026-07-29 (method unchanged)
spatial_resolution_geometry: Network edges + POI points/representative points of polygons
filter_rules_or_tags: network_type=walk, undirected, retain_all; services snapped if <=200 m from graph; categories: food_retail, health, education_childcare, food_drink, civic_daily_services, recreation
network_or_model_parameters: Speed 1.34 m/s; threshold 15 min only (~1,206 m); decay s=exp(-d/700), beta=700 m; multi-source Dijkstra
weights_or_formula: Category weights 0.25/0.20/0.15/0.15/0.15/0.10; weighted sum then min-max to 0-100
aggregation_to_500m_hex: Hex centroid accessibility score on walk network
transformation: Beyond cutoff score=0; else quintiles among accessible cells for classes; continuous 0-100 for modelling
missingness: 655/1539 cells beyond 15 min for all categories (validation)
polarity_high_means: Better walking access to daily services
notes_limitations: Walking index is 15 min only (not dual 5-15). OSM completeness varies. Not re-downloaded in v1.

dataset_product: OpenStreetMap bike network + same service POIs as walking
filter_rules_or_tags: network_type=bike, undirected; services snapped if <=250 m; same service taxonomy as walking
network_or_model_parameters: Speed 15 km/h; threshold 5 min (1,250 m); decay exp(-d/1800), beta=1,800 m
weights_or_formula: Same category weights as walking; min-max 0-100
transformation: Beyond-cutoff class + quintiles among accessible; continuous 0-100
polarity_high_means: Better cycling access to daily services
notes_limitations: OSM bike network completeness varies. Not re-downloaded in v1.

dataset_product: OpenStreetMap bike network + same service POIs as walking
filter_rules_or_tags: network_type=bike, undirected; snap <=250 m; same service taxonomy
network_or_model_parameters: Speed 15 km/h; threshold 15 min (3,750 m); decay beta=1,800 m
weights_or_formula: Same category weights as walking; min-max 0-100
polarity_high_means: Better cycling access to daily services
notes_limitations: OSM bike network completeness varies. Not re-downloaded in v1.

dataset_product: OpenStreetMap PT stops/stations + OSM walk network
filter_rules_or_tags: Stops snapped if <=200 m; categories: bus_stop, platform/stop_position, rail/tram, transport_hub
network_or_model_parameters: Walk speed 1.34 m/s; threshold 10 min (~804 m); decay beta=1,000 m
weights_or_formula: Composite = 50% nearest all-stop score + 50% weighted PT-category composite; 0-100
notes_limitations: Stop-access potential only; no timetable, frequency, transfers, or fares

dataset_product: OpenStreetMap PT stops/stations + OSM walk network
filter_rules_or_tags: Same PT categories as 10-min indicator
network_or_model_parameters: Walk speed 1.34 m/s; threshold 20 min (~1,608 m); decay beta=1,000 m
notes_limitations: Stop-access potential only; not full PT accessibility

dataset_product: GeoDanmark composite official_landcover_natural.gpkg (from geodanmark_odense_official.gpkg / GEODKV WFS; classes include skov, vaadomraade, kratbevoksning and related natural features; total natural ~42.1 km2 in Odense clip)
provider_source: GeoDanmark via Datafordeler (GEODKV); portal Dataforsyningen / Klimadatastyrelsen
year_or_download_date: Downloaded 2026-07-29 (product registration dates per GeoDanmark feature)
filter_rules_or_tags: Official natural/green GeoDanmark classes in composite (not OSM leisure tags); agriculture not included as green in this composite
transformation: Continuous %; also used as green_share_norm in env quality/burden
polarity_high_means: Higher official natural/green share in cell
notes_limitations: Official natural land cover; not necessarily publicly accessible green space. Replaces OSM green used in previous run.

dataset_product: GeoDanmark composite official_blue.gpkg (soe, bassin and related water features; ~4.0 km2)
provider_source: GeoDanmark via Datafordeler (GEODKV); Dataforsyningen / Klimadatastyrelsen portal
filter_rules_or_tags: Official water features in blue composite
weights_or_formula: blue_area_m2 / cell_area_m2 * 100; enters env_quality/burden via blue_share_norm (quality weight 0.08)
notes_limitations: Component of environmental composites; not a standalone GMM feature

dataset_product: protected_nature.gpkg / ecological_health_vector.gpkg = WDPA (Protected Planet DNK) union LBST paragraf3_protected_nature.gpkg
provider_source: UNEP-WCMC Protected Planet (WDPA); Landbrugsstyrelsen (LBST) via geodata.fvm.dk
year_or_download_date: WDPA DNK extract Jul 2026; LBST downloaded 2026-07-29
filter_rules_or_tags: Merged protected / §3 nature features clipped to Odense
weights_or_formula: eco_area_m2 / cell_area_m2 * 100; eco_share_norm weight 0.12 in quality; low_eco in burden 0.10
notes_limitations: Citation: UNEP-WCMC via protectedplanet.net (DNK)

dataset_product: GeoDanmark composite official_builtup.gpkg (bygning, bykerne, hoejbebyggelse, lavbebyggelse, erhverv, etc.; ~86.7 km2)
provider_source: GeoDanmark via Datafordeler (GEODKV); Dataforsyningen / Klimadatastyrelsen portal
filter_rules_or_tags: Official built-up / settlement GeoDanmark classes in composite
weights_or_formula: built-up area / cell area * 100; also in quality (builtup_inverse 0.12) and burden (builtup 0.18)
notes_limitations: Replaces OSM building/landuse built-up from previous run

dataset_product: GeoDanmark official_roads.gpkg (vejmidte); major roads filtered by trafikart/vejkategori
filter_rules_or_tags: Major classes only (Motorvej, Hovedrute, Primær/Sekundær routes, etc.); ~112 segments used after filter
weights_or_formula: buffered road area / cell area * 100; quality road_burden_inverse 0.10; burden road_burden 0.15
missingness: None (0% possible); mean ~1.29% (stricter than previous OSM 100 m buffer)
notes_limitations: Definition change vs previous OSM 100 m motorway–tertiary buffer; not measured noise/air

dataset_product: Official multi-source: natural, blue, built-up, major roads, protected nature, noise vector, heat/noise/air rasters
provider_source: GeoDanmark; WDPA; LBST; Vejdirektoratet; ESA CLIM4cities; Open-Meteo/CAMS (air interim)
spatial_resolution_geometry: Polygon overlays + 50 m road buffers + rasters (~50–100 m)
filter_rules_or_tags: See component variables; weights only applied to non-constant available indicators then renormalised
weights_or_formula: v1 quality weights (pre-renorm candidates): green 0.18; blue 0.08; builtup_inverse 0.12; road_burden_inverse 0.10; official_natural 0.15; eco 0.12; noise_share_inverse 0.08; heat_inverse 0.09; noise_mean_inverse 0.08 → min-max * 100
missingness: Raster gaps possible (heat valid 1526/1539; noise mean valid 389/1539; air 1539/1539)
notes_limitations: Official-first v1; air is interim CAMS proxy pending DCE. Highly correlated with env_burden (|r|~0.96).

dataset_product: Same official multi-source layers as env_quality
filter_rules_or_tags: Same components; burden polarity (low green, high built-up, heat, noise, air)
weights_or_formula: v1 burden candidates: low_green 0.12; builtup 0.18; road_burden 0.15; low_official_natural 0.10; low_eco 0.10; noise_share 0.10; heat 0.12; noise_mean 0.08; air 0.05 → min-max * 100
notes_limitations: Excluded from GMM due to near-perfect correlation with env_quality

dataset_product: heat_raster.tif from ESA CLIM4cities Sentinel-3 SLSTR downscaled LST (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20863040)
year_or_download_date: Scenes Jun–Aug 2020–2023; processed to Odense raster 2026-07-29
filter_rules_or_tags: Mean of summer scenes over Odense bbox; units °C; LST not air temperature
weights_or_formula: Zonal mean per hex; heat_mean_inverse_norm in quality (0.09); heat_mean_norm in burden (0.12)
notes_limitations: Land surface temperature, not canopy air temperature

dataset_product: noise_vector.gpkg / noise_raster.tif — Vejdirektoratet Støjkortlægning af statsveje 2022
filter_rules_or_tags: State roads only (not full municipal road network)
network_or_model_parameters: Midpoint of Isov1–Isov2 dB band for rasterisation
weights_or_formula: Zonal mean dB and/or noise_share; enters quality/burden
missingness: noise_mean valid 389/1539 (many cells outside state-road noise footprint)
notes_limitations: State roads only

dataset_product: air_quality_raster.tif — Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS-based)
filter_rules_or_tags: Interim only; strategy is to replace with DCE Luften på din vej / AirGIS
used_in_gmm_clustering: Indirect (small burden weight via env composites)
notes_limitations: INTERIM — do not claim as Danish national air quality mapping; replace with DCE

dataset_product: dst_kvadratnet_population.gpkg built from (i) 1 km population density class map PopulationDensity_InMainDistrict (classes 1-19…400>) from Urban Science_Odence accessibility Geographic Data; (ii) municipality total KOMM_TOT_21 = 205,987
provider_source: Density classes: project GIS layer with DST-style legend; control total: municipal Basisdata_o KOMM_TOT_21.dbf (kommune 461)
year_or_download_date: KOMM_TOT year 2021; density class layer ~2025 project file; hex product built 2026-07-29
spatial_resolution_geometry: 1 km square density-class cells (n≈330 unique) areal-interpolated to 500 m hex
weights_or_formula: raw = midpoint × cell_km2; scale so Σ = 205,987; pop_density_km2 = hex population / hex km2
aggregation_to_500m_hex: Areal interpolation from 1 km class grid
transformation: Continuous density; also morphology feature in GMM
missingness: Age fields NaN; density range in hex validation 0–1626 persons/km2; total ~205,981
notes_limitations: NOT paid Statistics Denmark Kvadratnet person counts. Density-class estimate scaled to municipality total. Suitable as morphology/urbanity proxy; not census-grade hex population.

dataset_product: Derived from hex total population / density (age/socio if available)
filter_rules_or_tags: Only non-constant available components used; weights renormalised
weights_or_formula: Min-max 0-100; available components only (density; age/socio if present); migration-origin excluded
notes_limitations: Total population only; migration-origin fields not used; excluded from typology clustering

dataset_product: Basisdata_o/Befolkning/KOMM_TOT_21.dbf (TYPE=Maend/Kvinder; ALD_0…ALD_110)
filter_rules_or_tags: Maend + Kvinder rows; exclude deaths/moves rows
weights_or_formula: Total = 205,987; used as control total for density scaling
aggregation_to_500m_hex: Not disaggregated to hex (no age on hex)
notes_limitations: Documented for appendix context; hex age/sex still unavailable without DST Kvadratnet or BEFOLKNINGSDATA×1km crosswalk
